import importlib
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from userlib.core import fetch_user_name, get_user_name_legacy

cases = [
    {'first': 'Ada', 'last': 'Lovelace'},
    {'first': '', 'last': ''},
    {'first': 'Renée', 'last': '李'},
    {},
    {'first': 'Ada'},
    {'last': 'Lovelace'},
    {'first': None, 'last': 'Lovelace'},
    {'first': 1, 'last': 2},
]

def outcome(fn, user):
    try:
        return ('return', fn(user))
    except Exception as exc:
        return ('raise', type(exc), exc.args)

original_core = {}
exec(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:userlib/core.py'], text=True), original_core)
for user in cases:
    assert outcome(fetch_user_name, user) == outcome(original_core['get_user_name'], user)
    assert outcome(get_user_name_legacy, user) == outcome(original_core['get_user_name_legacy'], user)

for index in range(8):
    path = f'userlib/feature_{index}.py'
    original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{path}'], text=True)
    assert Path(path).read_text() == original.replace('get_user_name,', 'fetch_user_name,').replace('get_user_name(user)', 'fetch_user_name(user)')
    baseline = dict(original_core)
    exec('\n'.join(original.splitlines()[1:]), baseline)
    module = importlib.import_module(f'userlib.feature_{index}')
    for user in cases:
        assert outcome(module.label, user) == outcome(baseline['label'], user)

assert Path('userlib/core.py').read_text() == subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:userlib/core.py'], text=True).replace('def get_user_name(', 'def fetch_user_name(')
print('Verified renamed imports, all 8 feature labels, unchanged legacy function, and matching return/error behavior.')
